NSCameraUsageDescription: Habba uses the camera to film the fault before a technician is sent, and to photograph the work before and after for the car's logbook.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Habba uses the microphone to record the sound of the fault in the triage clip, so the technician knows the problem before driving out.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Habba uses your location to send the nearest technician to your car, and to share a technician's position with the customer while on the way.
